record.paper_title: Graph Partitions: Recent Progresses and Some Open Problems
record.original_question: For every integer k at least 2, does every graph G with m edges and n vertices have a k-partition (V1, V2, ..., Vk) such that max over all pairs i < j of e(V_i union V_j), the number of edges induced by the union of those two parts, is at most 6m/binom(k + 2, 2) + O(n)? In addition, when the minimum degree delta(G) is at least c(k)n for some constant depending only on k, can the O(n) additive term be removed?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k \ge 2$ be an integer. For a (finite, simple) graph $G$ with $n$ vertices and $m$ edges, a $k$-partition of $G$ is an ordered partition $(V_1, V_2, \dots, V_k)$ of its vertex set $V(G)$. For $S \subseteq V(G)$, let $e(S)$ denote the number of edges of $G$ with both endpoints in $S$.

(a) Prove or disprove: there exists a function $f_k(n) = O(n)$ (depending only on $k$) such that every graph $G$ with $n$ vertices and $m$ edges admits a $k$-partition $(V_1, \dots, V_k)$ satisfying
$$\max_{1 \le i < j \le k} e(V_i \cup V_j) \;\le\; \frac{6m}{\binom{k+2}{2}} + f_k(n).$$

(b) Show, moreover, that there exists a constant $c(k) > 0$ such that if the minimum degree $\delta(G) \ge c(k)\, n$, then the additive $O(n)$ term in (a) can be removed; that is, $G$ admits a $k$-partition with
$$\max_{1 \le i < j \le k} e(V_i \cup V_j) \;\le\; \frac{6m}{\binom{k+2}{2}}.$$
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture was described as "wildly open" in the surveyed literature. Subsequent work by Fan and Hou (Random Structures & Algorithms, 2017, "Bounds for pairs in judicious partitioning of graphs") and by Xu and Yu ("Better bounds for k-partitions of graphs", Combinatorics, Probability and Computing) establishes improved bounds approaching the conjectured value and resolves related problems of Bollobás and Scott in the affirmative, providing partial/asymptotic progress, but the exact bound 6m/binom(k+2,2) + O(n) for all k ≥ 2 (and the dense-graph statement without O(n)) does not appear to be fully settled.

status_evidence.title: Bounds for pairs in judicious partitioning of graphs - Fan, Hou
status_evidence.snippet: Fan and Hou (2017) establish bounds for max_{i<j} e(V_i ∪ V_j) in k-partitions, addressing the Bollobás-Scott problem asymptotically.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress toward the conjectured bound is known.

status_evidence.title: Better Bounds for k-Partitions of Graphs - Xu, Yu
status_evidence.snippet: The paper answers a problem of Bollobás and Scott in the affirmative and settles another problem of Bollobás and Scott regarding bounds for k-partitions.
status_evidence.claim: Related Bollobás-Scott partition problems are resolved, but the exact conjectured constant 6m/binom(k+2,2) for the pair-union version is not stated as fully settled.

status_evidence.title: On several partition problems of Bollobás and Scott - Ma
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses progress on several Bollobás-Scott partition conjectures including the pair-union conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is treated as a major open problem with partial results.
